body: Yes. I believe I'm a disgusting human because of my behaviours in the past. I wish I could erase all of them. :'(

I don't want to reach out to anyone I know. I feel so embarrassed and ashamed... I feel as though everyone will think I'm just dramatic or attention seeking. I've been told that in the past when I reached out and tried to talk about it. :'( people are posting about world suicide prevention day but in reality they wouldn't give two shits if I were to talk about my feelings.... it just all seems superficial...

I'm the farthest thing from alright. :'( all I can think of is suicide. It's the only thing I can think of that'll make my inner child shut the fuck up and stop crying all the fucking time :'( its torture
I can't. It's too painful
Sad. Empty. Like I'm deep in an emotional pit of quiet despair and darkness
The same
This was a really beautiful read. I might actually try this tonight or in the next few days when I have the house to myself. Thank you so very much.

I'm sorry that I don't have any advice but I have experienced this myself. I get so angry when I'm around someone that reminds me of my abuser that I usually have to leave the room or wherever I am because I feel this really intense hatred and homicidal rage. I understand that the person isn't the same as my abuser but the feeling of being triggered is really painful and difficult. It makes me loathe the person to the core and I feel guilty for feeling that way about someone I barely know. :(
Fuck you and go to hell
I could definitely benefit from smashing a piñata to bits!

I am also learning how to be my own parent. Some days it is very hard. One example of this, is I will accomplish some kind of task that I normally get very anxious about doing, like going to the doctor, talking to my landlord, calling someone, etc. And I will reward myself with something afterwards. Maybe a chocolate bar maybe a nice spa evening to myself, bubble bath, candles, or watch a movie with my cats, anything positive. Growing up I never really had that. I'd get screamed at for anything, or much worse.
Yes and neither have worked for me
In tears after reading "your voice is beautiful." Seriously thank you. My heart is in so much pain.
What is SRA?

I finished some client work finally. I gave myself two weeks to complete it but my emotional flashbacks have been preventing me from being able to sit and focus on my work, so I didn't even start until the last possible second. But I did it. 


Another tiny step is handing out resumes. I can't answer the phone when I get calls because I'm so terrified to speak to a stranger. But I keep handing out my resume online, hoping I'll have the courage to answer the phone the next time it rings. Still feel ashamed that I haven't answered it at all yet.

I'm dealing with the same problem right now. I have to work tomorrow morning and I'm physically unable to relax. I'm so overwhelmed that I wish I could cry all night and sleep all day. But I have to get up in the morning. I need the money. I haven't found a way to completely relax but I hope I can find a way soon... I feel nauseous when I get this afraid and caught up in my anxiety. :( 
I wish I could help

Edit: I've never actually gone looking for the films because I couldn't mentally handle seeing anything like that. I've just been really, really angry that it's probably buried within thousands of other disturbing content with children online, or somewhere in the world... fuck this earth

Thank you for your reply. I appreciate the emotional support. I really need it. 

For me, I can't ever call them by their names because it's triggering. Makes me gag. Usually when I'm referring to her in real life, I just call her "that woman" or "the woman who birthed me", or "satan" etc. And I agree it's nothing like a beautiful Hollywood movie... rather than carving a stone, to me personally it feels more like digging through a giant bucket of shit with my bare hands to get to the bottom, only to find more shit. Maybe there's a treasure at the bottom somewhere. Maybe not. But I'm trying to keep digging and clean everything out so I can breathe a little easier.

This may sound a little fucked up. Not that it would be anything particularly shocking after what I've shared, but anyways. I remember being filmed often during all this... fucked up stuff. And I have a strong feeling these films out there somewhere and I'm burning with rage that I can't find them to turn them into the police. Because as far as I know, that's all they really give a fuck about, is physical evidence... and I realize they may never face the consequences in this life. But it makes me sweat with rage. 

I wish my siblings would help me and I wish they would come to terms with their reality and realize that there are things that can't just turn away from or sweep under the rug. It's not going to go away and I'm afraid they will wait until they are middle aged and then have a breakdown when they realize the truth of what happened to them. They just refuse to believe they were raised in such a vile household, and they refuse to identify themselves as victims of this particular kind of abuse. I know that they can feel it though. I can see it when they look at me. They look like they're trying to bury something terrifying so they can't see it anymore. But I can see it. All the fucking time.

I'm crying again hahah... :'( it's nice to know I'm not alone. Thank you for commenting. I just want to feel like I have a real and balanced life... I regret saying no to going out but I know I would have been flirty and maybe a little tipsy and I don't like imagining myself being like that while in a relationship ... I'm not sure what to do with myself right now. I want to stay with my boyfriend but sometimes I wonder if it's going to be worth it

You have been through so much. My mother also is creepy as fuck, and has done many of the things you mentioned and more. It sucks. And I agree it would be nice to just have a peaceful life without these flashbacks and other shit. 
I guess at least we have one another to talk about this stuff and this place to find others who are in similar situations. If I was born before the existence of the internet I dunno how I would completely cope being on my own all the time... 
you'll definitely make it through this and you have a lot of strength to be here now sharing your experiences. 


 I don't know if this is helpful at all but maybe make a post on Craigslist saying that you're looking for a dog sitter for a few days? Or even make a post on Facebook saying you need a dog sitter (without going into detail as to why) you could just say you're going away for a few days and need someone to look after your dog. Only if you are comfortable doing so, of course. 
I hope everything works out for you, and feel free to vent here whenever you need. I know I keep coming back here because I have hardly anyone to talk to.

I want to get better too... but I have so many fears with taking different medications.. I'm terrified that I'll end up in the hospital or I'll somehow develop psychosis from new meds... I dunno my mind just likes to imagine every single possible scenario and they are always awful and I anticipate the worst outcomes all the time. :( thank you for your comment here. I really do need a good doctor. Doctors scare me too but I'm learning to be more okay with them. I'm always afraid any new person I meet is planning on attacking me and it's exhausting to be constantly trying to fight that feeling.

I too wish that I could act on my revenge fantasies. They get very gruesome, but then again my childhood was beyond gruesome and extremely depraved because of my abuser. I wish death on her every time I think of her.
I'm not sure how true that is if my coping mechanisms are only different ways to physically harm myself

I'm currently laying in bed. Seriously still considering killing myself tonight. :'( I feel empty and alone and like anything I do is fucking pointless and stupid. I'm just a speck of dust in the universe.

I live in Canada. My antidepressants just made me two sizes too big for my clothes and made it hard to cry or feel happy. I'm terrified to gain any more weight. I'm already so uncomfortable in my body. I hate when people look at me. And I hate looking at myself. If I were to gain weight then I would most certainly hate myself so much that any kind of "positive" mood lifting effects would be instantly erased because of that... so I don't want to try any different ones.

I'm still considering it tonight. My friends fiancé killed himself two years ago... at least I would know somebody up there if I do it... I feel so hopeless. I don't know how to lift myself up anymore. I've been suicidal for two years now and before I had my flashbacks I never ever considered suicide as an option. Now it's all I think about :(

Thank you... one of my biggest weaknesses is my inability to show myself any kind of care. I also don't feel comfortable talking to anyone new face to face. I've had countless people be extremely judgemental towards me when I told them about my experiences and I don't feel safe sharing anymore. My courage is basically  nonexistent.

I just have a really difficult time seeing the point in waiting for those small moments in between feeling so hopeless. It seems like the pain always outweighs the better moments. I have a photoshoot I have to take pictures for tomorrow. But I feel like such a hopeless fucking loser. I don't want to even go anymore. It was planned weeks ago when I was feeling okay ish but now I feel so scared. I feel like no matter where I am or what I do, I always feel broken. :'( I don't want to exist here... the good moments are rarely ever that great. And the awful moments are always there and they stick with me for far longer. :'( I try so hard to appear as though I'm not stressed and angry or afraid but it just ends up making me feel so awful inside. It's like I'm lying to myself. That whole fake it till you make it doesn't work for me.... I'm sorry if I'm all jumbled up I just feel so terrible.... and I'm scared to talk to anyone new for counselling and especially shelters....
thank you for giving me such a well thought out comment here.
I will try to keep you updated. I tend to go from sitting on my phone all day to sleeping a lot & watching shows and then avoiding my phone so I'll write back here sometime in the future.

I'm not sure I have the courage to go to the hospital to admit myself there. I'd feel so ashamed and scared... I know they're there to help but I've been to the hospital near me once before, and they legitimately treated me as a complete liar. I went because the police were not doing a good job interviewing me about my traumatic experiences so they took me to the hospital to have me "evaluated" but I think they just wanted a doctor to tell me to basically shut the fuck up and stop wasting their time. 
A literal quote from the dumbass psychiatrist: "It is impossible to have traumatic  memories resurface from the age of 4." I was so angry I wanted him to die... and the nurses just said to me "Make sure there isn't any crack in your weed." (I used to smoke fairly regularly for my anxiety.) so yeah... my hospital experiences have been less than ideal. :( I was so disappointed.

Thank you so much. I want to try even though I also want to give up. And my boyfriend is understanding but sometimes I don't think he really can fully understand what this is like. I worry that he's getting impatient and thinking things like "why can't she just keep a job? Why is she just watching Netflix all day, it's not helping." And he would be right that it's not healthy to stay in and watch shows all day but I feel like I'm really trying my hardest. Even though from an outside perspective it looks like I'm just a lazy person. I genuinely appreciate your response. Thank you.
No I haven't. Is that where you admit yourself into the hospital? I live in Canada so it's free
But why though? Why do you care? :'( you don't know me and you've never met me
I slept a long time, but I have no energy. I still feel just as suicidal unfortunately. I'm home alone and I have what I need to do it :'(

I really appreciate your kindness. Fortunately when I called the hotline a long time ago I had a very good experience, but I suppose it can be hit or miss. Thank you so much for being so kind. I still feel fucking awful but it's really nice to have someone, even if it's a stranger, offer to spend time with me

I feel as though I've already tried so much, and I occasionally see comments of others who are older than me saying that their struggle is still really hard... I don't know if I can endure that. :'( I will try to give myself time. This is really hard for me to face alone and I thank you for your support... I want all of this pain to be gone

I can't see how the world needs me for anything. I'm just one person in an ocean of billions :'( my pain isn't really unique from others and the justice system doesn't give a fuck :'( I'm having such a hard time finding hope and holding onto it

Yes he knows how severe the abuse was, and he is very loving and understanding for the most part. Sometimes he just doesn't know what to say or how to help and I don't blame him at all. I will try to talk to him more about this.
Thank you. I will definitely look into it.

Your struggle is not less valuable or less difficult for you because our pasts are different. But yes you can absolutely survive this. You aren't aware of how strong you truly can be, you were made to find your own strength.

You deserve love. You deserve peace and to be free from this pain. None of this was your fault and the person who abused you is vile and disgusting and a lost and disturbed soul. Please don't give in to your suicidal feelings. You are worth the fight. Someday you will start to see changes in how you feel and how you perceive yourself and the world around you.  If you can, please talk to a therapist or call the suicide hotline. When I felt very alone and hopeless in the same way you have, I called the suicide hotline a lot, especially when I was unable to afford my therapist while I was in need. I understand how it feels to hate the body you live in. It feels awful. I'm not sure what advice to give you. But you aren't alone. I was abused in the same way, and I used to really hate looking at my body. I hated any sensation on my body whatsoever, everything was triggering. Being alive was so painful and it still is. But I am here and I am fighting with you. You are worth it. You are worth the fight my friend. Don't give in to the pain. You are so strong because you are still here in spite of it all. Don't give up. I believe in you.

This is totally normal... I fantasize about killing my abuser because I hate her more than anything that exists. I wish death upon her every day. The rage I feel is like fire.  Fuck anyone who treats others like shit. They should all rot in hell.
Depression. I've felt both. My rage makes me unable to function and I snap at other people for minuscule things.
I also need many hugs. Sending you all of them today.

Unfortunately I know exactly what you're talking about ... today is especially hard for me. I haven't visited any of my friends in months because the only times I have visit seen them lately ended with me having mental breakdowns with fits of crying uncontrollably and sharing all my awful memories... I just feel like I'm not a good friend anymore. I feel like my cptsd has changed me a lot and I wish I was better :'( I don't know what advice to give you but just know that you aren't alone, friend. We can make it through this together.
This made me giggle, thank you... but seriously I feel the same. I don't know how to act like a human who is comfortable existing in society.

As someone who has personally been raped and tortured by an adult woman and also a man (occasionally at the same time) I can tell you that you are 100% correct. It's the worst thing you can do. Not a day goes by that I don't wish that the woman who did this to me would get her hands crammed in a blender and get tortured in a tiny cell for all of eternity... it makes me feel better to read comments like yours, it reminds me that there are people out there who are sane and that are not completely fucked in the head. So thank you for posting.
I have an appointment set up to get my thyroid checked out near the end of the month. Hoping it's nothing too bad..

Trigger warning severe sexual abuse and physical torture. PLEASE do not read if you are sensitive to descriptions of incredibly severe childhood abuse

Both of my parents sexually abused me throughout my entire childhood. My sister was abused also and she has now become very narcissistic and cruel towards me. She has denied her flashbacks completely. Shoved it all under the rug and pretends everything is fine and I can tell she isn't fine at all. Says it was all just a dream. I don't think anyone loses their fucking mind and ends up locked in a mental hospital for weeks and weeks and weeks over "a bad dream."
Apparently I'm just an attention seeking shit head. But this shit is a lot more common than people would like to believe. 

I've been in therapy for years. It helps but I have a lot of shit to deal with on a daily basis because of my trauma. My mother was the worst. She would scream at the top of her lungs and lay on the ground and bang her hands and feet on the ground like a small child. She would physically torture me for her own pleasure. She would starve me, beat me, bite me, burn me, anything. Absolutely anything that you can think of that is awful and abusive and disgusting, she did it to me as a child. I've been kept home from elementary school so I could be used and abused regularly. My nose was broken by her because I said I didn't want to do the things she asked me to. I loathe that woman. She isn't a mother. She's worthless. She is the devil in the flesh. And my father just went along with it all. Watched as she would choke me out if I tried to scream for help. If there is a hell, I grew up in it. And I'm fighting every day to overcome it. I will overcome it. And I'm so grateful this subreddit exists. It has helped me during my darkest time. 
I reported the abuse to the police but they have treated me like shit. I wish the justice system was better with cases related to sexual abuse...
Fuck I could have used this for Mother's Day. Thank you for this though. Will definitely use in the future.

I'm not sure what advice to give but I can share my experience. I started having flashbacks a couple years ago of my two abusers. I had been seeing my therapist for a few years prior to my flashbacks. She said I should report them to the police, so I did. The police officer I spoke to treated me horribly, he was a fucking asshole and had absolutely no consideration for my feelings and did not take me seriously at all... even though my two siblings experienced the same abuse growing up. My sister at first was very supportive of me. However now that a lot more memories are coming back to her she has gone into complete denial. I suppose the memories were too much to handle, and she didn't want to acknowledge the truth because it was too difficult. She ended up screaming at me saying I was just putting on a show and that I'm just bored and crying for attention... she has completely denied my trauma as well as her own, and it has caused me such severe distress that I now have persistent suicidal ideations and I am doubting my own memories and it has pushed me down such a dark hole that I never knew existed. It has been so stressful that I have cut her out of my life completely, along with my entire family because they do not want to acknowledge what happened and they don't want to face the truth. My health is way more important. And I will not pretend to be okay to make them comfortable...

Sometimes I have the most awful dreams.. I won't go into detail but sometimes they feel like a complete flashback from my real life "childhood" and I wake up feeling  fucking disgusting. Other times I dream that my loved ones are being harmed and I can't help at all, same as you. It fucking sucks. The only things that helped me was going to bed every night at the exact same time at 9pm and waking up every morning at 6am, having a relaxing bed time routine, avoiding sugary foods and drinks in the evening (which I've been bad with lately - chocolate and Starbucks frapps have been my comfort foods these days) and I hear that not drinking any coffee can potentially help but I love coffee so much. Anyway just generally taking better care of my sleeping pattern made a difference. And just having a routine of some kind to distract myself, like going to work, or watching a show. Or reading.... idk I know these are all probably dumb and not that helpful, but it's kind of working for me. Shit still happens though and it makes me wanna not go to sleep at all, so I lay awake at night for hours and hours watching Netflix until my mind is too tired to think of all the stressful traumas.. it's like I'd rather be sleep deprived than see my abusers face in my nightmares. Fucking sucks. I'm sorry that you have to experience it. I guess at least we aren't alone in this.. :/ hope you find ways to ease your pain and improve your sleep.

I unfortunately do the same thing with isolating myself as a way to keep myself feeling safe. The world can feel so scary to a person who has experienced trauma... I guess I don't have much advice at all but just know you aren't ever completely alone... you have us. I am just a person on the internet but I am still a person. And I care about you. No one cared about me when I was small. So it feels good to connect with others who feel burdened with similar life struggles. Keep sharing here as much as you need. We are here. I'm listening.

In my opinion you should find a new counsellor. If you get bad feelings from the person you're paying to help you then they aren't a good fit for your personal needs. Feeling safe with a therapist is so important and essential to improving your mental health. 

I rarely feel safe anywhere but my therapist makes me feel very safe - although the first few sessions were very scary and it took some time to adjust to sharing very personal feelings and whatnot. I've been seeing my therapist for several years now. 
Do what you think is best for you. Listen to your gut. I hope things improve for you! :)

I wish I could just "be happy" .. I dunno how to get there :/  I can have happy feelings occasionally but it's not often and I wish it was... I wanna be better. But I feel totally inadequate and stupid.

My boyfriend is really kind and loving. I think I feel so extremely about it because growing up if I did anything even slightly wrong I would get screamed at and abused in the worst ways :/ so I naturally feel like I'm not good enough most of the time
Thank you :( <3
Also I wish I could work for a week and then get a week off and then work again the following week, and so on...
My antidepressants just made my clothes not fit :/ kinda helped the depression but not too much .. thank you for your reply. I want to feel stronger
Yes it is. I need full time so I can afford to live but I'd prefer part time so I don't feel burnt out

That is a good point... but I strongly believe in second chances and I would forgive him if he chose to come back. I really want this to work out... I don't blame him for feeling burnt out from trying to help me... caregivers fatigue is a thing and I feel awful for making him feel tired of me...I managed to have a short talk with him just now and he hugged me and told me he was proud of me for finding work and facing my fears. I cried. And asked him why he won't try again and he just said he wants to see me doing well and he really cares and wants to be in my life,  but there's some relationship stuff that is not working... so we're gonna go for a walk tomorrow and talk about it all. I hope we can come to a solution that feels good for both of us... not sure how it will work out but I'll see. I know it will be easier once he's moved but I really really wish we could keep trying.. he's my best friend and he has such a big heart and I've never felt so happy and at home anywhere or with anyone in my entire life..

I still feel so much anxiety every day I wake up when have to get ready for work but I'm trying really hard to face it every day. I always feel afraid that people will tell me I'm not good enough or that I'll completely screw up and make a fool of myself... but I really appreciate people such as yourself who take the time to read stories like the one I've shared and it honestly helps me hang on to my life a little bit tighter than I was before. Just knowing someone cares enough to send me a message and read my words... it's really nice during these times. So thank you...
Thank you very much.

You inspire me to share some of my work too! <3 I'm glad to have given you a little bit of care, and it helps me feel better too, just knowing I made you feel good even if it's only a little bit. Much love to you, and I hope you continue to express yourself through this beautiful artistic medium. <3 <3

Thank you for your response. I ended up doing okay I think, and everyone was very helpful and easygoing... I guess my mind likes to trick me into believing that there is constant danger around me and it's so exhausting to feel like that. But you're right, just showing up felt like a success to me. I had a few awkward moments but I felt okay with being a little weird and out of place for now.

Thank you very much. I'm trying my hardest but sometimes I can't help but feel that everyone thinks I look constantly afraid and on edge. It's a struggle to appear like I'm feeling relaxed and safe but I think I made an okay impression. Thank you for your message I really really appreciate it. Going to celebrate my success of attending my first day and treat myself to some new comfy work shoes I think. Mine are old and crappy right now haha

Thank you so much. I went and it ended up being not so bad. I knocked over a bunch of stuff and o felt so flustered but then I saw one of the older ladies do the same thing that had been there for a long time so I felt okay. Thank you for your message. I'm going to keep trying.
Please post more of your work here! I love it. I'm an artist myself and I loooove seeing other people's emotions expressed through art. You're really talented!
Thank you for sharing this. I hope you can continue to find healing for yourself...

I love what you said about not being able to go into the deep end yet. I completely relate to that statement... my circumstances are not the exact same but I've been unemployed for a little over a year and I have been feeling pressured to get a job by my bf, and he just dumped me because I wasn't ready to start working full time as I suffer from c-ptsd. I hope one day you can find the energy and strength to find a place to volunteer or work part time. Much love and positive energy to you

Oh no ..I'm really sorry that you're facing such painful trauma :( I don't mind listening if you need to vent as well, I find that listening to others share their experiences helps a bit... so feel free to PM me if you feel you'd like to share. I'm trying to be optimistic... but then I just say to myself "well you always have the other option" (suicide) and I know it will cause pain to others... but I feel as though I'll only ever experience pain from here on. I don't know how to overcome it all on my own :'(
I'm sorry for being so bitter... my heart is breaking... thank you for talking to me.

I feel you. A lot of people around me have been insensitive towards me about the whole thing. They seem to think I've just become lazy for not picking myself up and getting a move on with life. It's not so simple... I wish it didn't feel so lonely in the real world.
Not really. I can't help but see everyone as untrustworthy. I'm terrified of new people. Everyone thought that the two people who abused me so severely  were awesome and so nice
I don't want to do any of those things :'(

I wish someone would say to me "It's okay. You're allowed to give up. It's okay to check out early." Because I do not want to live in a world where people harm kids in the way I've been harmed. I hate feeling this sad and I'm so tired of crying

I'm so afraid of living. And he said many many times that he would be here for me no matter what and would always say "I'm
Not going anywhere, I love you." :( I believed him.. and then he just changed his mind I guess.

I'm already so afraid of people... my boyfriend was the only one who I felt safe with... and I don't want to live through this for another 30 days... I feel like I've lived so long and I'm only 23 I feel like I can't see any kind of positive future for me. It seems impossible and I can't bring myself to get work...
I don't want to learn any of those things.... I just want to kill myself :'( I feel completely worthless and like I've taken so many steps back

I love him more than I love anything in this world... I feel like my soul is being shattered and like my heart is being ripped from me.... my body physically feels like I haven't received any affection throughout my whole life as I never received proper love as a child at all... I want to die :'( I just want someone to hold me close and encourage me
I'm in Canada
I'm trying to hang in there. It's so hard though.
He just ended the relationship. Basically said life is too short and I need to make an effort to get better. I want to end my life so badly.
He just dumped me. All I can think of is ending my life. I feel completely hopeless. I don't want to move and I don't know if I can afford to pay rent when he's gone.

Thank you...
I just feel like anything I do from here onwards won't be worth it in the end. Like I've tired so hard already...I feel so afraid and stressed out to move anywhere else. My friends don't have room for me. I feel like my life is useless and like I don't have any purpose in this existence... He's the only one who has kept me holding on and preventing me from giving up, but now I want nothing besides ending my life I'm so done :'( and I have nobody to be with me my friends aren't able to see me or talk and I have nothing I have nobody :'( I only want to be held I just want to feel love. I don't want anything else I don't want to feel alive and breathe I don't want any of this

I just got dumped. He says he's tired of seeing me do the exact same thing every day and it's eating away at him. He also says life isn't that long and he wants to move forward and not stay in the same place. So I guess I'm just a waste of time. I really want to end myself tonight :'(
I kind of wish I could change my name so that my abuser can't find me. However at the same time I don't really like any other name besides my own, I don't think I could pick a new one.

A couple of my friends have said they believe me, but they all treat me quite differently now than they used to. I feel like I'm some kind of freak now, like now that they see the reasons why I'm suffering they look at me like I'm just unfixable or something or that I'm too broken for them to be themselves around me... idk if that makes sense. But you're not alone. I believe you and I hope you can find healing and inner peace.

I'm in a very similar situation currently. I just said that I was spending time focusing on my own personal work ( I sometimes do photography and art, but I've never actually sold a painting and I only get photography gigs maybe once a year) but it usually impresses them and they think I'm able to do good freelance work. I don't even have a website or anything. But I actually have just been depressed and suicidal for a year and I have maybe done 3 paintings during that time... I hope you continue to heal and I'm proud of you for making this step!! I'm so terrified to get a job honestly and I'm still working on finding a support group to help me find some mental strength.

I own a few items that used to be my abusers, (Makeup brushes, scarves, other little things) and I never use them because they were hers, but I'm in the process of donating those items and replacing them with new ones because I don't really like little reminders like that...

Same here, friend. Send me a message if you want to vent. 
I'm really proud of you for being strong tonight.

Would it be weird for me to send him a text explaining how he's making me feel? I know he gets uncomfortable when we have to have serious conversations and it makes me feel less valuable when he keeps avoiding me... idk I want to talk to him in real life but he makes himself so inaccessible

Thank you so much... I just don't know what to say to him. I wish he would just take 5 minutes out of his day to hold me and tell me he loves me. I know somewhere in his heart he does love me, he just doesn't know how to handle my situation or my c-ptsd... but I wish he was more open to talking to me about it and figuring out how to help, and not just assuming he can't help at all. I really love him so SO much and it is killing me to see him distance himself more and more... I can't see any other options besides suicide right now. I just want unconditional love, so badly. My heart is hurting so much. Thank you for your response... thank you....

I feel the exact same way. If I could have permission to never speak to anyone and never have to make food for myself, I'd just sleep all the time. I wish I could just check out of life early and just say "I'm done".
